inputs.heading: Three deliverables make a simulation realistic
inputs.subtitle: Your project does not carry all three yet. The engine will still run, but it will have to estimate what is missing — and a scenario built on estimates is worth exactly what those estimates are worth.
inputs.illustrationAlt: Three deliverables feed the projection; the missing ones leave it trailing off into dashes.
inputs.note: Nothing is blocked: you can start the reading now. The report will state, line by line, what was estimated for lack of a source.

businessPlan.label: Business plan
businessPlan.effect: Without it, the offer, the market and the business model are inferred from the project description.

finance.label: Financial forecast
finance.effect: Without it, prices, costs and starting capital are estimated from the sector and the country.

communication.label: Communication strategy
communication.effect: Without it, customer acquisition cost and growth pace are assumed — the two figures that decide your break-even date.
